اقترضنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضْنَا (iqtaraḍnā) /iq.ta.radˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضْنَا (uqturiḍnā) /uq.tu.ridˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
